The amount of people trashing $btc in favor of $doge have no grasp of reality if they think the former tanks, the latter won't go down with it. Which is why this is all so silly. $tsla should've never gotten involved in the first place, total pr stunt that has backfire potential.

Attention to crypto has definitely cooled recently but $doge is on the verge of a massive breakdown on top of the decline its already seen. It spent 4 days in its history $.08-.16, doesn't take a genius at TA to know that gap is likely to be filled. If $btc goes <$30k, it's gg.

I'm not sure what's worse for Robinhood $hood... The fact that a decline in $doge revenue is why the quarter was so bad or they aren't making a dime off the move in $shib. Should've gone all in meme coins but once they went public/took on more debt they became the establishment.

Why does Dogecoin still have a $58b market cap? In the age of $Fartcoin, $Trump it seems so yesterday. There's a basket of meme coins that will be a dream short & $doge despite it's "longevity" tops the list. We live in an idiocy but zero utility eventually gets what's coming.
